indexes.//: Reminder dispatcher (functions/src/index.ts): per-user scan for open work carried forward from an earlier day. An equality-style `in` on status plus a range on scheduledDate needs a composite index.

fieldOverrides.//: Reminder dispatcher writes one small `reminderLog/{yyyy-MM-dd}` claim per user per day to make the at-least-once scheduler tick idempotent. Nothing reads a claim older than the day it guards, so let Firestore's TTL collect them instead of accruing 365 docs per user per year.
